items.text: kal call karna
haan ji
shaam ko
thik hai
kya karna hai
firse call kar lena

items.context: Aap kab call receive kar sakte hain?
items.text: shaam ko
kal dopahar

items.context: Kya aap kal call lena chahenge?
items.text: haan ji
Mujhe call karna hai kal subah timing mein
Main abhi phone pe busy hoon baad mein baat karenge
Kya aap kal mere office pe contact kar sakte hain?
Mera naam Rahul Singh hai jo pending dues ke baare mein baat karni hai
Kal dopahar do baje call kar lena mera address Delhi mein hai
Mujhe delayed payment ko lekar call karna hai kal hi
Shaam ko call kar lena mujhe address bhej do pehle
Mera naam Priya hai main kal call karna chahti hoon

items.context: Aapke account mein kitni quantity pending hai?
items.text: Main karib 5000 rupees pending rakhta hoon call karna hai mujhe
Jee main address Pune mein hai kal subah me call karenge

items.context: Kya abhi call lena mumkin hai?
items.text: Main call receive nahi kar paunga abhi isliye kal karna please

items.context: Aapko kab call mil sakti hai?
items.text: Mujhe kal shaam 6 baje tak phone karna confirmation chahiye
Main Bengaluru se bol raha hoon mera naam Anil Kumar aur kal dopahar baad mein call karna
Mera account Mumbai mein registered hai aur main chunta hoon agle hafte call back milega
Mujhe apne pending balance ke baare mein kuch saaf saaf jankari chahiye phone par kal subah baat karenge
Kal main apne ghar par available nahin hoon isliye shukravaar ko shaam ke 7 baje call kar lena
Maine 3 din pehle payment kiya tha magar abhi tak update nahin hua hai to call kar lena please
Mera pta hai New Delhi mein 25 sector mein please kal dopahar 2 baje call kar lena mujhe
Main aapke department mein call karna chahata hoon kyunki payment delay hua hai to call kar lena kal

items.context: Aap kab call lene ke liye free honge?
items.text: Mujhe kal dopahar baad mein call karna hai kyunki main abhi kaam mein hoon thoda busy hoon

items.context: Aap apna naam aur jagah bataenge?
items.text: Mera naam Sunita Sharma hai aur main Lucknow se baat kar rahi hoon payment confirmation ke liye kal call karoge

items.context: Aapko call kis wajah se chahiye?
items.text: Main apne account statement ko lekar thoda confusion mein hoon isliye kal subah 11 baje call karna

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: callback_request - asks the agent to call back at another time
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
